result.analyst_notes: Mostly corporate 'we' voice with an aspirational, mission-driven tone. A named six-value list is prominent, and commitments use 'committed' and 'strive' language with few measurable targets. Access and affordability framing addresses customers early. Shareholders appear only in one investor relations line, and safety is absent.
